purpose: Prevent the final Excel from presenting heterogeneous price evidence as if every material had one equally reliable China RMB low/mid/high band.

CHINA_BAND.label: 中国同规格价带已建立
CHINA_BAND.rule: Multiple comparable China-market same-spec anchors or a clear same-seller ladder support a provisional low/mid/high band.

CHINA_ANCHOR.label: 中国同规格锚点
CHINA_ANCHOR.rule: Useful China-market same-spec quote(s) exist but a full three-tier band is not justified.

FOREIGN_WHOLESALE_ANCHOR.label: 海外批发同规格锚点
FOREIGN_WHOLESALE_ANCHOR.rule: Explicit size/count/hole/price wholesale evidence exists outside China; retain original currency and market, do not silently convert into a China RMB band.

FINISHED_PRODUCT_ANCHOR.label: 成品市场锚点
FINISHED_PRODUCT_ANCHOR.rule: Only finished bracelet/strand/product price is reliable; do not back-calculate per-bead raw price unless count/spec supports it.

BRANCH_REQUIRED.label: 商业分支需拆分
BRANCH_REQUIRED.rule: One generic band would hide materially different commercial branches (e.g. Nanhong ordinary/persimmon/cherry, obsidian sheen branches).

TREATMENT_REQUIRED.label: 处理状态需披露
TREATMENT_REQUIRED.rule: Price evidence is usable only with explicit treatment branch/status; treated material is not automatically fake or low tier.

IDENTITY_RISK.label: 材质身份风险
IDENTITY_RISK.rule: Marketplace naming is too ambiguous to form a trustworthy natural-material band without identity verification.

SPECIALIST_MATERIAL.label: 专业材料模型
SPECIALIST_MATERIAL.rule: Identity/treatment/origin/species/weight/luster/certificate variables precede price comparison; do not force a universal 8mm three-tier band.

NO_DIRECT_PURCHASE.label: 不直接采购
NO_DIRECT_PURCHASE.rule: Taxonomy/design parent or placeholder; no purchase price row.

HOLD.label: 暂停
HOLD.rule: Required upstream material/structure decision is not yet made.

market_currency_rule: Every displayed price keeps its original market and currency. If a convenience converted value is later added, it must be a separate calculated field with FX date/source and must never replace the original quote.
latest_evidence_rule: For export, resolve each material/spec from the latest applicable evidence across price-evidence-v1..v7 and specialist-pricing-evidence-v1..v5. Later deltas override earlier status only when they explicitly strengthen/correct the same material/spec; rejected/quarantined quotes never contribute to a natural-material band.

explicit_examples.rule: Do not label as China RMB low/mid/high unless China comparable anchors are later found.
Keep commercial 8mm price anchors but show treatment disclosure; do not imply untreated natural-color citrine.
Ordinary, 柿子红 and 樱桃红 branches stay separate.
Natural amber/beeswax, reconstructed/pressed amber and resin imitation are separate material classes.
